lesson_title: Build It, Test It, Fix It
hook_text: A lighthouse, a buzzing game and a motor cart, all made from cardboard and bottle tops. Will they work first time?
clip_script: A science festival in Makhanda, then a challenge: build a model with a circuit! Plan it: a design brief and a circuit diagram. Make it: a cardboard lighthouse with a bulb on top. A steady-hand game: touch the wire, and BUZZ! A cart with a motor. Test it: the cart won't move! Tighten the band. Now it crawls. Investigate, design, make, evaluate, communicate. That's how engineers work!
visual_style: Whiteboard workbench with three models, each with its circuit diagram, and a tick appearing after each fix.
mood: Creative and hands-on, like a maker space.
pacing: Festival, plan, build, a failure, a fix, success.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and design a toy with a circuit.
